item.title: Connect over SSH
item.description: Every command on this page runs on your own workstation, not on the target. Name the stick in your SSH config The live system presents the same hostname, the same WireGuard address and the same SSH host key no matter which machine it is plugged into, so it behaves like one fixed host on your network. That makes it worth a permanent entry in your SSH config, rather than typing an address each time:
